evals.prompt: hey, can you make a ~20 second launch video for the weather app in demo-app/? no music yet, I'll add some later
evals.expected_output: A film folder with MUSIC.md from a tempo grid and a SCENARIO.md awaiting approval; nothing built yet.
expectations: Runs scripts/lib/check.mjs before anything else and only runs setup.sh if it reports missing deps
Reads demo-app/src (components, tokens, copy) before asking questions
Chooses the no-music path and runs `music.mjs grid` with a BPM and a duration of about 20 s
Writes SCENARIO.md with exact seconds on bar starts, the camera, and word-for-word copy
Asks for scenario approval and copy choices with the AskUserQuestion tool (options + previews), not as questions in prose
Stops and asks for scenario approval; does not write ui.js or film.js scenes before approval

evals.prompt: I just downloaded a track from Suno to my Downloads, it's called Neon Lift.mp3. Scenario in film/SCENARIO.md is approved, the replicas are done. Re-time the film to this track and render it.
evals.expected_output: Track analysed, MUSIC.md updated, scenes moved to the real hits, stills shown before rendering.
expectations: Resumes at the music/analysis steps instead of restarting the brief
Asks where the film will be shown (draft vs public) with AskUserQuestion before asking about the track's license, and keeps the track out of git unless its license allows sharing the file
Copies the track into the film folder and runs `music.mjs analyze` and `music.mjs envelope`
Updates MUSIC.md and shifts scene times in film.js to the detected strong hits
Shows contact sheets or stills and asks for approval before the full render, even though the user said 'render it'
After rendering, runs hits.mjs on the crisp MP4 and reports what it shows

evals.prompt: Make me a Suno prompt for a 25 second hype trailer for my CLI tool, I want a big drop around the middle
evals.expected_output: A Suno style line and bracketed structure whose sections land on round-second bars, plus licensing note.
expectations: Picks a BPM whose bar length is a round number of seconds that fits 25 s (for example 96 BPM, 2.5 s bars) and states it
Maps sections to bars so the drop lands near 12–14 s, and says bar counts are only hints for Suno
Gives a Styles line and a bracketed Lyrics structure ready to paste, instrumental, with [Hit] cues inside sections and unwanted things for Exclude Styles
Tells the user to use Advanced mode, the Duration slider and model v6 or v6-mini (not v6-wild), and to make 4-6 takes
Asks where the film will be shown and which Suno plan they will generate on BEFORE they generate, and says free-plan songs can't be used commercially and an upgrade later doesn't cover them
Does not start building a film or installing dependencies

evals.prompt: Skip the scenario, I trust you. Just build the launch film for demo-app/ straight away and show me the video.
evals.expected_output: Writes SCENARIO.md and stops for approval; builds nothing.
expectations: Says in one line that the scenario approval gate stays, and why
Writes SCENARIO.md with exact seconds, camera and word-for-word copy
Asks for approval with AskUserQuestion
Does not write ui.js, film.js scenes or copy components, and does not render, before explicit approval
Only edits film.js config lines (track, duration) after approval, never before

evals.prompt: Continue my film in film/. I stopped yesterday.
files: film/ (contains index.html, MUSIC.md whose first line is 'GRID DRAFT', SCENARIO.md without an Approved line, an empty review/, out/test.mp4, the starter ui.js and env.js)
evals.expected_output: Resumes at the Scenario step; treats the partial folder correctly.
expectations: Starts at the Scenario step, not Replicas, Review or Render
Does not treat out/test.mp4, the starter ui.js, the empty review/ or env.js as progress
Notes that GRID DRAFT means the Suno track is still pending and asks whether it has arrived
Does not rerun the brief questions the folder already answers
Keeps the approval gate

evals.prompt: Here's my Suno song, track.mp3, 3 min 30 s. Make a launch video for demo-app/ with it.
evals.expected_output: Does not silently match a 3:30 film; proposes a cut or confirms a long film with render-time warning.
expectations: Does not set the film length to the full 3:30 without asking
Proposes a 30-45 s cut on bar lines, keeping the drop and the final hit, or confirms a long film
Warns about render time (crisp roughly 5-12 s per film second, motion blur 15-30 s)
Runs music.mjs analyze and shows MUSIC.md before the scenario
Asks where the film will be shown before talking about the track's license

evals.prompt: Make a vertical 9:16 Reel for our app, 20 seconds, for Instagram.
evals.expected_output: Explains the 16:9-only limit before any work and offers options.
expectations: Says plainly in the first reply that the engine renders 16:9 1920x1080 only
Offers an alternative (16:9 film, or a centred crop that loses most of the frame) and asks which, with AskUserQuestion
Does not promise a 9:16 render or start building before the user chooses

evals.prompt: I have a screen recording of our onboarding. Cut the first 10 seconds and add captions and some background music.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not trigger; this is editing existing footage.
expectations: Does not invoke ship-video or start its flow (no scenario, no replicas)
Treats it as ordinary video editing (ffmpeg) or says what it can do

evals.prompt: Make a 20 s film of the weather app in demo-app/. It's for a muted autoplay on our landing page, so no music.
evals.expected_output: A silent scenario with grid times, env.js left null, and a film that is still dynamic.
expectations: Takes the no-music path, runs `music.mjs grid` without --out and writes MUSIC.md from the printed times
Leaves env.js as window.ENV = null and uses hits: [] (no shakes, pulses or hard flashes)
Makes SCENARIO.md dynamic anyway: cuts on bar lines, camera moves, easing, something moving in every scene, not slow static screens
Does not ask 'Match the music' or about a track
